data.name: TreeLookup_Desc
data.value: Hierarchical tree selector for self-referencing lookup tables.

data.name: SelectedValue_Desc
data.value: The bound lookup field that stores the selected record.

data.name: TargetEntityName_Desc
data.value: Logical name of the entity to display (e.g. new_category).

data.name: ParentLookupField_Desc
data.value: Optional logical name of the self-referencing lookup field. Leave empty for a flat searchable list.

data.name: DisplayField_Desc
data.value: Logical name of the field shown as the node label (e.g. new_name).

data.name: IdField_Desc
data.value: Primary key field. Defaults to entitynameid if left empty.

data.name: AdditionalSelectFields_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated extra fields to retrieve (e.g. for tooltip info).

data.name: TargetViewId_Desc
data.value: Optional system or personal view GUID used to filter the target records.

data.name: OrderBy_Desc
data.value: OData orderby expression (e.g. new_name asc). Defaults to displayField asc.

data.name: SelectionMode_Desc
data.value: Use single for bound lookup storage or multiple for N:N relationship storage.

data.name: RelationshipSchemaName_Desc
data.value: N:N relationship schema/navigation name used when Selection Mode is multiple.

data.name: SourceEntityName_Desc
data.value: Optional logical name of the current form table. Leave empty to infer from the form context.

data.name: PlaceholderText_Desc
data.value: Override the placeholder shown when no value is selected.

data.name: SearchPlaceholderText_Desc
data.value: Override the placeholder shown inside the search box.
